what: Filesystem modification times establishing that each registration and its .sha256 sidecar existed BEFORE the script that consumed it and before the deposit it produced. RESULTS_3d_r214.md's header asserts that ordering; this file makes the assertion checkable without filesystem access to the project.
caveat: mtimes are filesystem metadata and can be altered: they are evidence, not proof. AND THEY RECORD LAST WRITE, NOT PRODUCTION. CHANNELS_G2_r219.json and WINDOW_G2_r218.json carry deposit_mtime identical to the second (2026-08-16 16:44:49), four days after their scripts, because both were EDITED after creation -- each carries a self_description_correction field reading 'corrected r220'. An mtime therefore cannot establish that a deposit is the output of the script named beside it.
not_covered: FIVE of the ELEVEN deposits cited by RESULTS_3d_r214.md have no prereg field and no registration: SPEEDGATE_r203.json, HEADLINE_FIGURES_r215.json, HIPGAP_r220.json, PRIMARYB_RESULT_r179.json and PERMREACH_r226.json. Section 9 rests on the first two; section 3 rests ENTIRELY on HIPGAP_r220; section 6's second table row rests on PRIMARYB_RESULT_r179; HEADLINE_FIGURES_r215 is also the sole cited container for section 7's first table row and all of section 8b; and PERMREACH_r226 is the sole container for section 4's r226 correction. Three earlier versions of this field understated the scope -- the first named two deposits, the second four, and none named PERMREACH_r226, which did not exist when the first two were written.

r226 per-channel reach counts.note: PERMREACH_r226.json has NO pre-registration. It was produced to measure a claim a cold read found unsupported, mid-round, and no registration was written before it ran. It is the container behind the most consequential correction in RESULTS_3d_r214.md section 4 and it is the least-covered file in the set. Recorded rather than smoothed.

what_this_file_establishes: That a registration and its .sha256 sidecar existed on disk before the LAST WRITE to the corresponding deposit. That is all.
what_this_file_does_NOT_establish: that a deposit is the output of the script named beside it -- deposits were edited after creation
when any script was EXECUTED -- no execution time is recorded anywhere
that a registration was not altered before its sidecar was written
anything about the four deposits with no provenance group (see not_covered)
inventory_is_hand_maintained: The counts in this field and in RESULTS_3d_r214.md's header are MAINTAINED BY HAND. They froze at r224 while section 4 moved to r226, which is how PERMREACH_r226.json came to be absent from an inventory claiming completeness. A hand-maintained inventory that claims completeness is a promise that will break again, and this note exists so a reader treats the counts as a claim rather than as a generated fact.
